Values.//copy-me: Copy this file to local.settings.json (gitignored) and adjust. Every value below is safe to commit; never put real secrets in this example.
Values.//storage: Azurite (the local storage emulator) satisfies AzureWebJobsStorage for free and is auto-started by the 'azurite' task in .vscode/tasks.json. Azure uses a real storage account set by infra.
Values.//auth: Dev auth lets the SPA log in by sending X-Dev-* headers. NEVER enable in production.
Values.//entra: Production sign-in via Microsoft Entra External ID. Leave Authority/Audience blank locally to keep the provider inert.
Values.//store: UseInMemoryStore=true uses the ephemeral in-memory store (no setup). Set it to false to use the Cosmos DB Emulator at the well-known connection string below, which persists data across restarts.
Values.//nutrition: USDA FoodData Central key. DEMO_KEY is shared and rate-limited (~10/hr); get a free key at https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/api-key-signup.html.
Values.//openfoodfacts: Barcode reads work out of the box. Contribution (write-back) requires BOTH EnableContribution=true AND UserId/Password; WriteBaseUrl defaults to the .net STAGING host.
Values.//anthropic: One Anthropic key powers label OCR and the AI assistant. Both degrade gracefully (and say so) while it is blank.
